title: claude --bare -p fails to authenticate although the normal session is signed in with Pro or Max
symptoms: A --bare run fails on authentication while the same command without --bare works
CI job that relies on a subscription login breaks after adding --bare
cause: Bare mode never reads OAuth credentials or the system keychain, so a Claude subscription login is not used. Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry keep reading their own credentials.
fix: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to a key created in the Claude Console, or supply an apiKeyHelper in the --settings JSON.
